messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a complete, playable 3D zombie-survival game set in a city, with an eagle-view camera and support for phones and tablets.

## Requirements
- User requested: “Buat kota yang di isi oleh zombie, dan bikin kameranya jadi eagle view (3D Game, Phone/Tablet)”.
- Build now without clarification; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them at completion.
- For visual checks, save small JPEG screenshots (viewport at most 1280px wide) and inspect only the latest.

## Decisions
- Built a top-down/isometric city survival game called “DEAD CITY” with Indonesian UI, mobile joystick/buttons, and desktop keyboard controls.
- Objective: collect three supply cases, then reach extraction; zombies pursue and attack the survivor.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created game interface and responsive styling in `index.html` and `style.css`.
- Implemented Three.js city scene, survivor, zombies, combat, supplies, extraction, HUD, pause, and win/lose states in `game.js`.
- `node --check game.js` passed.
- Started the game server on port 3000; opened it in Playwright and inspected screenshots at `screenshots/dead-city.jpg` and `screenshots/dead-city-play.jpg`.

### Active
- None.

### Blocked
- Browser showed one 404 for `/favicon.ico` and WebGL performance warnings; game rendered and was playable in the browser.

## Next Move
1. If further validation is needed, continue the running server at `http://localhost:3000` and use the existing Playwright session.
2. Consider addressing the favicon 404 if desired.
3. Finish with a brief Indonesian summary and note assumptions.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game UI and overlays.
- `style.css`: Responsive desktop/mobile layout and controls.
- `game.js`: Three.js game implementation.
- `screenshots/dead-city-play.jpg`: Latest gameplay screenshot.
- `screenshots/dead-city.jpg`: Initial/title-screen screenshot.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- Three.js loads from `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.160.0/build/three.module.js`.
- Playwright showed title `DEAD CITY — Outbreak Survival`; gameplay screenshot was captured after clicking `#start-btn`.
